verdict.rationale: Mistral's pricing page says "you can self-host our models anywhere," and its docs index a Model weights page with download links. Model cards label flagship releases such as Mistral Large 3 as open-weight. Community reports corroborate local and self-hosted use, including Devstral running locally and EU firms choosing Mistral for self-hosted deployment. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosting or deployment guide (serving stack, hardware requirements), clarity that every model is open (some, such as OCR and Medium-tier models, appear API-only), self-hostable versions of platform features like the Agents API and built-in tools, and clear commercial-use terms, since some commercial deployments require a separate Mistral license.
